mapper.insert: INSERT INTO daily_highlight (briefing_date, headline, based_on_count, generated_at) VALUES (#{briefingDate}, #{headline}, #{basedOnCount}, now()) ON CONFLICT (briefing_date) DO UPDATE SET headline = EXCLUDED.headline, based_on_count = EXCLUDED.based_on_count, generated_at = now()
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT COALESCE(n.published_at, n.collected_at)::date AS briefing_date FROM news n JOIN news_analysis na ON na.news_id = n.id ORDER BY briefing_date
